newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Body Shop's HK franchise mulls listing.
newsitem.headline: Body Shop's HK franchise mulls listing.

text.p: Body Shop Hong Kong, the local franchise of Britain's Body Shop International Plc, intends to list on the Hong Kong stock exchange, the South China Morning Post reported on Saturday.
The newspaper quoted the company's managing director, Wilson Chu, as saying the listing would take place after the company expanded its sales network.
"We have a target to list the company in Hong Kong," Chu told the Post.
"But it will come after expanding our sales network in Hong Kong and possibly in China," he said.
Officials from the cosmetic and skin care chain in Hong Kong were not immediately available for comment.
The company has 13 outlets in Hong Kong and two in Macau.
Chu said the firm intended to double its outlets to 30 by 1999. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6441
